article.headline: Games To Watch: Pine Belt hosts division title game; unbeaten starts meet on court
article.html:
Pine Belt and Meridian HomeSchool play for a division title Saturday, November 7, while the evening basketball schedule brings several meetings between teams with unbeaten starts. The football game is listed for 7 p.m. Central; the selected basketball games begin at 5 p.m. or later.

Football: South Division championship at Pine Belt

Pine Belt hosts Meridian HomeSchool at 7 p.m. in a game the varsity listing identifies as the MSCAA South Division Championship. The Spartans enter 9-1 overall, with an 8-0 district mark, against a Meridian HomeSchool team listed at 4-6. It is an eight-man football playoff matchup with a stated division championship at stake.

Boys basketball: Blue Mountain travels to Calhoun City

Blue Mountain visits Calhoun City at 5 p.m., as the game page and Tippah Sports schedule confirm. The Cougars’ last posted final in the checked record is a 55-48 win over Thrasher on November 3. Friday’s scheduled Jumpertown result has not been posted, leaving Blue Mountain’s current record unconfirmed here. Calhoun City is listed at 0-1.

Girls basketball: unbeaten visitors and hosts meet

Meridian visits Madison Central at 5:40 p.m. with a 2-0 record, against Jaguars listed at 1-0. The Wildcats return to the road after a 54-35 win at Starkville on Friday. The non-conference matchup in Madison puts that winning start alongside another team without a posted loss.

Neshoba Central travels to Oak Grove for a 6 p.m. girls game in Hattiesburg. The Rockets enter 1-0 and the Warriors 2-0 in the current matchup listing. Like Meridian-Madison Central, this is an early-season comparison between teams with different numbers of wins and no losses on the record sheet.

Boys basketball: winning starts on the Coast and at Raymond

Picayune visits Ocean Springs at 5 p.m., with both boys teams listed at 1-0. The non-conference game gives the Maroon Tide a road test and the Greyhounds a home opportunity to follow their opening victory.

Raymond hosts Laurel at 7:30 p.m. The Rangers are 3-0 after a 69-61 win over Terry on Friday, while the Tornadoes enter 1-0. That makes the later boys matchup a meeting between the longer opening winning run and a visitor looking to build on its first listed win.

Boys basketball: Starkville looks to respond

Starkville hosts Callaway at 7:30 p.m., a day after its 55-49 loss to Meridian. The Yellowjackets are listed at 0-1 and the Chargers at 1-1. The non-conference game gives Starkville another home appearance early in the season following the school’s 2026 boys Class 7A championship.

Boys basketball: an opening look in Olive Branch

Olive Branch hosts Cleveland Central at 6 p.m. Both teams are listed at 0-0 in the current game page, offering an early look at the Conquistadors and Wolves. The game is non-conference.

For the broader Friday recap, including Meridian’s boys and girls wins at Starkville, read our Scores from last Night edition.
